import json
import numpy as np

with open("evaluations.json") as f:
    data = json.load(f)

cols = ["cashew cream", "coconut oil", "coconut milk", "tapioca starch", "potato protein", "lemon juice", "locust bean gum", "xanthan gum", "glucono-delta-lactone"]
X = []
y = []
iters = []
for d in data:
    if d["iteration"] == 2:
        continue
    r = {item["ingredient"]: item["fraction"] for item in d["recipe"]}
    X.append([r[c] for c in cols])
    y.append(d["target_dissimilarity"])
    iters.append(d["iteration"])

X = np.array(X)
y = np.array(y)

# Look at X relative to X5 (Iter 5, index 3):
x5 = X[3]
y5 = y[3]
for i in range(len(X)):
    dx = X[i] - x5
    dist_l1 = np.sum(np.abs(dx))
    dist_l2 = np.linalg.norm(dx)
    dy = y[i] - y5
    print(f"Iter {iters[i]:2d}: y={y[i]:.6f}, dy={dy:+.6f}, L1={dist_l1:.4f}, L2={dist_l2:.4f} | dx={np.round(dx, 4)}")
